subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core session-level process/step event contract now, and if so what taxonomy, persistence, replay, authorization, and redaction rules should it use?
rationale: The source gap is real, but this would become a durable gateway/session API that can expose sensitive intermediate run state across clients and sessions, so automation should not choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Design core process events
options.body: Create a single additive gateway/session contract for process.* and step.* events with stable IDs, bounded replay, and explicit observer/redaction policy.

options.title: Narrow to one consumer first
options.body: Defer the broad process taxonomy and solve one consumer, such as inter-session progress or Control UI activity, without promising a general process ledger.

options.title: Keep existing streams for now
options.body: Continue supporting lifecycle/item/tool/session.tool/session.operation streams and require integrations to use those until maintainers sponsor a larger contract.

recommendation.title: Design core process events
recommendation.body: Create a single additive gateway/session contract for process.* and step.* events with stable IDs, bounded replay, and explicit observer/redaction policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-cutting history across gateway protocol, agent events, session goals, audit metadata, and Control UI event surfaces involved in this decision.
